quality.review_scope: Independently source-audited selected scope: all seven colloidal temperature variants and zinc treatment from main Experimental and SI TableS1, with linked XRD/TEM/EDX/optical results. Downstream film/device/phase-transfer and incomplete ligand-omission controls are explicitly outside this package; retained in private branch inventory. Full independent audit read all 9 main-paper and 9 SI pages. Third-agent sampling and website delivery are tracked separately from this scientific review.
missing_fields: No measured atomic-coordinate asset or definitively resolved cubic/tetragonal distinction.
Most routes have no directly imaged particle shape; TEM distribution only for 130 and 170 °C.
Later centrifugation speeds/times, drying duration, and low-temperature treatment ramp are not reported.
PL spectra and SAXS series remain source figures; unlabelled values were not digitized.
Downstream ligand exchange, film/device procedures and controls are inventoried privately but not claimed as curated routes here.
conflicts: Preferred cubic assignment is qualified by cubic/tetragonal ambiguity and CuAu-type Raman interpretation. ZnS could not be independently distinguished; neither uniform shell nor atomistic interface is established.
Main Figure1a and prose disagree on which XRD method gives 3.2 versus 3.3 nm for the largest sample; retain exact trace label and method-specific text.
